dialogues.speaker: Vilora
dialogues.text: That's right! You have to pass the fitness test to join the Druzhna...

dialogues.speaker: Vilora
dialogues.text: Ugh, you have no idea how demanding those in charge of the test are! They even make you run... tell me, in what world would a proper lady have learned to run before???

dialogues.speaker: Vilora
dialogues.text: My mum says if this were back in the day, all a Vila noblewoman needs to join the Druzhna would be a letter recommendation... And now they want to assess you first??? That's ridiculous!
